meta.title: Validation Gates — machine-readable
meta.note: Gates must be registered before a scored window opens. Changing a gate after results exist is a gate violation and is recorded as such.

gates.name: Sample size
gates.rule: hold the threshold against n_eff, not raw n

gates.name: Robustness
criteria: edge sign stable across window halves
edge survives a second independent window
placebo shuffles do not reproduce edge

gates.name: Risk of ruin
gates.auto_fail: unbounded downside with no stated cap

gates.name: Economic reality
criteria: edge survives using only release-time best quote
no implausible stake to produce claimed ROI

gates.name: Demotion to paper (live → paper)
applies_to: any strategy whose status is live
criteria: rolling z_skill < 1.0 over the most recent 100 graded bets
two consecutive scheduled gate re-runs fail any blocking gate G0-G7
median max drawdown > 25% of bankroll while live (G5 breach in production)
gates.action: status flips live → paper immediately, staking stops, and the strategy may re-enter only through a freshly registered window that passes G0-G7 again
gates.evaluation_cadence: every scheduled gate re-run (weekly during the season)
gates.status: defined, not active — no strategy is live yet
gates.why: Enforcement half of the signal/staking split: a strategy whose measured signal has decayed must stop trading on a past reputation, whatever its staking run still shows.
gates.ratification: thresholds are proposals until the owner ratifies them (question Q-21)

scoring_rules: score only inside the registered window
passes are logged (a strategy with no denominator is invalid)
report raw and top-5%-trimmed ROI together
champion requires two consecutive qualifying windows
two failed windows demote; no sitting on old results
challenger runs a full shadow window before displacing a champion
all entrants evaluated on identical frozen inputs

rewards.season_0: paper league - titles and badges only, no funded pool
rewards.season_1_plus: requires funded pool, eligibility rules and jurisdiction review (Q-07)
design_rules: no reward for a single hot window
vacate and log titles later shown invalid
